patches_added.name: Spoof signature
patches_added.description: Restores push notifications by spoofing the original app signature.

patches_added.name: Unlock custom time picker
patches_added.description: Enables picking a custom date and time when snoozing conversations and scheduling messages.

patches_modified.name: Ad Removal
patches_modified.description: Removes all ad displays: navigation bar banner, native feed ads, live streaming banner ads, live video feed ads, live square ads, conversation Google ads, marriage guide card, four-select-one card, daily selection card, visitor list ads, likers ads, meet likers ads, meet visitor ads

patches_modified.name: Bypass Google Sign-In
patches_modified.description: Bypasses SHA-1 check by using embedded WebView OAuth for Google Sign-In.

patches_modified.name: Bypass license check
patches_modified.description: Bypasses PairIP license verification.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Crashlytics, Sessions, and Analytics.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium features
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium capabilities.

patches_added.name: Mark SDH Subtitles
patches_added.description: Marks detected English SDH tracks in embedded and addon subtitle lists.

patches_added.name: Android Auto Manifest
patches_added.description: Adds the Android Auto CarAppService declaration, meta-data, and permissions to AndroidManifest.xml.

patches_added.name: Android Auto Resources
patches_added.description: Adds the automotive_app_desc.xml resource required by Android Auto.

patches_added.name: Android Auto allowlist (root)
patches_added.description: Registers the app in Android Auto's allowlist on startup when root is available; no-op without root.

patches_added.name: Change package name
patches_added.description: Changes the package name from com.huawei.maps.app to morphe.huawei.petal.maps by default, allowing the patched app to coexist with the original. Changing the package name can lead to unexpected issues.

patches_added.name: Huawei login fix
patches_added.description: Forces the Account Picker sign-in flow with WebView fallback, fixing login on devices without HMS Core.

patches_modified.name: Bypass login
patches_modified.description: Skips the mandatory account sign-in on launch and opens the app directly.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium features
patches_modified.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches_modified.name: Remove Wildberries ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Wildberries home banners, grid banners, profile banners, promo headers, product recommendations, and lottery popups.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches_modified.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Force system font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reddit search
patches_modified.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches_modified.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches_modified.name: Show view count
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.

patches_added.name: Third-party lyrics
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show synced lyrics from LRCLIB or KuGou in the lyrics panel.

patches_added.name: Custom DPI
patches_added.description: Forces a higher display density for this app only, so the whole UI scales up without changing system density.

patches_added.name: Playback in feeds
patches_added.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the RVX settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches_modified.name: Colorize comment indent lines
patches_modified.description: Replaces the default gray comment indent lines with color-coded lines.

patches_modified.name: Disable bottom navigation bar auto-hide
patches_modified.description: Prevents the bottom navigation bar from hiding when scrolling down.

patches_modified.name: Disable home feed auto-refresh
patches_modified.description: Disables the automatic refresh of the home feed after viewing a post or after being away from the app.

patches_modified.name: Disable home feed swipe
patches_modified.description: Disables the horizontal page swipe gesture used to switch feeds.

patches_modified.name: Disable home screen redirect
patches_modified.description: Disables the automatic redirect to the home screen after being away from the app or returning from the background.

patches_modified.name: Disable post detail swipe
patches_modified.description: Disables the horizontal swipe gesture used to navigate between posts.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot banner
patches_modified.description: Disables the banner that shows up after taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button from search bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the Ask button (Reddit Answers) from the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide awards
patches_modified.description: Hides the awards on Reddit posts and comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide community highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides the community highlights section.

patches_modified.name: Hide community menu badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the red notification badge on the community menu (hamburger menu).

patches_modified.name: Hide post view counts
patches_modified.description: Removes the "views" indicator from the post metadata.

patches_modified.name: Hide prominent search bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the new prominent search bar on the main screen. Applicable only to version 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches_modified.name: Hide share count
patches_modified.description: Hides the share count on Reddit posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide upvote scores
patches_modified.description: Hides the scores on Reddit posts and comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide user community badges
patches_modified.description: Hides the user community badges on Reddit comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide user flairs
patches_modified.description: Hides the user flairs on Reddit comments.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens external links directly without going through out.reddit.com.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads and telemetry
patches_modified.description: Removes ads and telemetry everywhere.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize share links
patches_modified.description: Unshortens and removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.

patches_modified.name: Block listings
patches_modified.description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics and Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Prevents Avito's force-update screen opener from launching update screens. Toggleable in Настройки Morphe.

patches_modified.name: Hide professional sellers
patches_modified.description: Adds a maximum seller review count to Avito search filters and hides or dims offers from sellers above that limit.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Настройки Morphe" entry to Avito's settings that hosts the configuration for the other Morphe patches.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Disables Avito ads by removing ad SDK entry points and short-circuiting commercial banner loading.

patches_modified.name: UI tweaks
patches_modified.description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.

patches_modified.name: Bypass anti-tamper
patches_modified.description: Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.

patches_modified.name: Remove TBank ads
patches_modified.description: Removes TBank stories and promotional surfaces.

patches_modified.name: Remove Wildberries ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Wildberries home banners, grid banners, profile banners, promo headers, product recommendations, and lottery popups.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.
